notes.title: Holidays 2016 update available
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/6a793782c4db5e36bd5decaec912e657e620fb01.jpg

Hi all!

Kopanito has been updated to v1.0 with new teams, one stadium, one new super-move, two achievements and several improvements.


⛄️ The new content for Holidays 2016

Four new teams available in the game: Elves, Reindeers, Santas, Snowmen (the new teams won't be removed after holidays, they will stay forever).

New stadium with an ice surface, similar to the Indoor Stadium. Doesn't change physics of the game yet, but looks cool ːkopanitosmileː

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/b48c720b1be783241a2e9e4f01a7c13eb1da6ae7.jpg


🎇 New super-move: Tesla-copter

This is 6th super-move available in the game. It's a flying machine shocking players in radius.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/e15b08004095b302da1a3ba699ac3aac4f355410.png

Tesla-copter always follows a player with the ball and allows him to shock other players in radius. There are 4 charges, after using the last one tesla-copter flies away.

Important: losing the ball means also losing control of the tesla-copter!


🥇 Two new achievements

In case you have not enough of the existing ones :)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/11b0b993d23c7dac49b51c8b1174db2d7d4adaed.png
Bookworm: Read the entire Guide available in the game

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/942d6a53ec99ed4bb1663d964cc8eb8c84ad1df2.png 
Ice Sculpting: Freeze 3 players at once


⚽️ Other improvements since v0.9.5

Goal replays now work in online matches. They cannot be disabled or skipped for now, but they are short, so hopefully it's not a problem.
Added Polish translation. Other translations will come soon.
Fixed shadows in the podium scene after a tournament (thanks Samuel Dodee).
Renamed "How To Play" to "Guide", added more content and made minor tweaks to increase text readability.
Unlocked red and blue classic balls as they may be used on the new Ice stadium.
Fixed player colors on the match summary screen.
Fixed invalid user info on goals after client has disconnected from an online match.
Fixed not being able to activate a controller in the menu using the Start button.
Other minor optimizations: garbage collector activity, packet size reduced for online matches.

Happy Holidays and have fun!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

⚽️ Kopanito on IndieDB ● Facebook ● Twitter ● YouTube ● Official Site

notes.title: Halloween update brings some cool goodies
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/16aba9b0c030d11ad3084ad325e64134c41d9035.jpg

Hi all!

Some great new features and improvements have been implemented in the game. Read about them below and have fun playing and mastering your skills. Practice makes perfect ːkopanitorobotː


Halloween goodies

You can find few new teams in the game related to Halloween: Vampires, Zombies, Werewolves and Pumpkins.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/ecc8bef59d21d26530d94cb86c8b877a530ceebf.jpg


Local friends in online matches

It's now possible for your local friends to participate in an online match. Multiple controllers can be activated, like in a local match (though there is no guarantee, that you'll be in the same team with your friends).

The shirts at the bottom right corner of the screen display status of connected controllers. The first, yellow shirt represents keyboard, the next one (red) is for the first gamepad and so on.

Press Spacebar to enable/disable the keyboard and the Start button to toggle a gamepad (like in the team selection phase before an offline match).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/e5700c708eaaff95e7b54373de27b193b785d151.jpg

You can also select multiple online modes at once when searching for a quick match.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/9d3b71bcc040d97444e24ef8b93259f5559148f2.jpg


Improved corners

Corner kicks now allow for more options. You can make a ground pass, a lob pass or a precise shot at the goal.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/c6b21d31f95f1b60d7873e9538bf420bfb85141e.jpg


Automatic passes are back

Automatic pass is where a pass receiver controlled by AI traps the ball (if possible). This feature is geared towards beginners and kids.

Automatic passes were present in the game few months ago, but then we decided they simplify gameplay, reduced possibilities, etc. and we introduced manual passes.

Actually the current system is an improved version, not exactly the same old pass system.

Automatic passes allow also to queue actions, e.g. pass the ball further or shot at the goal before the receiver traps the ball. Feel free to try this in the practice mode in the game.

Manual passes are in the game as they were before, but now the pass modifier key is required to be pressed to perform a manual pass. By default it's the Shift key on a keyboard and Left Bumper on a gamepad (the same button as used for sprinting, can be reconfigured in the options).

More advanced players are sprinting all the time, so they shouldn't feel a difference in passing.

So, we've combined two passing systems, giving more depth to the gameplay.

Note: Performing a header or bicycle kick on automatic passes isn't possible in most situations, you still need a manual lob pass for this purpose.

Note 2: Trying to beat the Professional or Legend AI using only automatic passes isn't a good idea, feel warned.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/f6f0ed399303eeeafba9f2957cc2c0c0bd773271.jpg


A new way of grass wearing down

We've changed how the grass is wearing down in the game. Now each battle on the pitch should give a different result. Grass will become worn in the 'hottest' areas of the field.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/d3695b9e5a3174af703bbd0de811e2d5bdbb2bef.jpg


Steam Overlay is working again on Windows

Yeah, we know, that working Steam Overlay isn't something special for other games. The base technology that we're using didn't co-operate with the Overlay in the past, but now things are improving.

It also means that Steam Link should work too, but please let us know!


Other changes

Updated the list of games on the Browse Matches screen.
Changed how fame points are awarded for a match. Awarding fame for online matches too.
Improved ball stealing. Now short time in the ball's vicinity is needed to steal the ball if someone is already dribbling.
Fixed Commonwealth Cup huge bronze medal on the modes list (thanks +papa+).
Another set of fixes regarding players being entangled in goal's net.
Fixed few controller connection/disconnection issues (thanks a.).
Fixed headers not being counted as shots.
Fixed possibility of a corner kick or throw-in on the Indoor stadium.
Allowing to change players before a starting whistle (before kick-off, corner kick, throw-in and goal kick).
Improved avatar loading in leaderboards.
Made match camera slightly faster.
Fixed supershot animation's wrong timing on replays in some cases.
Fixed too big player names on GIF replays.
Fixed possibility of using the freeze and teleport super-moves by multiple players from the same team at once.
A lot of other minor fixes, tweaks and optimizations.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

⚽️ Kopanito on IndieDB ● Facebook ● Twitter ● YouTube ● Official Site

notes.title: Bugfix release v0.8.1 available
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/b4db9af901cc26d557cb8f85bda9fddb3b8efa1e.jpg

Hi all!

Kopanito has been updated to v0.8.1 with many bugfixes, most of them reported by you!

Full list of changes since v0.8.0

Added Indoor stadium and Indoor Cup to the game (see previous news).
Reduced possibility of players being stuck in a goal's net (thanks GamBif, Da Pappa, NarcissusLovesEcho, Lee, Frank16Gr and others).
Fixed too much zoom in wider resolutions, e.g. 21:9 (thanks Aleksandar).
Fixed goalkeeper becoming idle during practice in rare cases.
Fixed players running in-place when colliding with goal's net.
Fixed no fans on stadiums in rare cases (thanks L!V3RPL).
Fixed player avatars appearing on the wrong side of the screen (thanks FUDO).
Fixed 'Team not found' error.
Fixed too early stopping challenge after a tournament match causing the error "Cannot read property 'progress' of null" (thanks Mamedovic).
Fixed cancelling GIF generation not working (thanks FUDO).
Improved goalkeeper's behaviour when intercepting the ball.
Reduced maximum distance when searching for lobbies (only players in the same world region can be selected for a match).
Improved the Indoor stadium: better collisions with walls, ball is more bouncy and has reduced friction. A frozen player shouldn't go through a wall when pushed. Some minor visual tweaks.
Fixed extended slow-motion when freezing a player performing super-shot (thanks Servasky).
Fixed no slow-motion during replays (thanks FUDO).
Fixed unlocking condition for the Continental League, in some cases it was unlocked too early.
Fixed 'no texture' bug in tournaments (thanks Sunny/fash).
Fixed the "Cannot read property 'name' of undefined' issue with Continental League (thanks planetdestroyer).
Fixed framerate issues in team select phase for non-english languages (thanks Richard's_Mustache).
Fixed thumbnails in stadium select and ball select widgets on Mac and Linux.
Fixed lobby invite button (thanks MonkeyJug).
Fixed "g.isP2PPacketAvailable" error (thanks bkno).

What's next?
We're now focused on improving online multi-player functionality. On our TO DO list are among others:

Allow activating multiple controllers per client.
Allow to select a team in the Create Party mode (this will allow you to play against AI).
Restore goal replays in online matches.
Expand the Browse Matches screen.
Correct fame points calculation for online matches.
and more...

Thanks everyone who reported issues and gave us valuable feedback, so we could improve this game. Have fun and report more :)

http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

⚽️ Kopanito on IndieDB ● Facebook ● Twitter ● YouTube ● Official Site

Fixed too much zoom in wider resolutions, e.g. 21:9 (thanks Aleksandar).
Fixed goalkeeper becoming idle during practice in rare cases.
Fixed players running in-place when colliding with goal's net.
Fixed no fans on stadiums in rare cases (thanks L!V3RPL).
Fixed player avatars appearing on the wrong side of the screen (thanks FUDO).
Fixed 'Team not found' error.
Fixed too early stopping challenge after a tournament match causing the error "Cannot read property 'progress' of null" (thanks Mamedovic).
Fixed cancelling GIF generation not working (thanks FUDO).
Improved goalkeeper's behaviour when intercepting the ball.
Reduced maximum distance when searching for lobbies (only players in the same world region can be selected for a match).
Improved the Indoor stadium: better collisions with walls, ball is more bouncy and has reduced friction. A frozen player shouldn't go through a wall when pushed. Some minor visual tweaks.
Fixed extended slow-motion when freezing a player performing super-shot (thanks Servasky).
Fixed no slow-motion during replays (thanks FUDO).
Fixed unlocking condition for the Continental League, in some cases it was unlocked too early.
Fixed 'no texture' bug in tournaments (thanks Sunny/fash).
Fixed the "Cannot read property 'name' of undefined' issue with Continental League (thanks planetdestroyer).
Fixed framerate issues in team select phase for non-english languages (thanks Richard's_Mustache).
Fixed thumbnails in stadium select and ball select widgets on Mac and Linux.
Fixed lobby invite button (thanks MonkeyJug).
Fixed "g.isP2PPacketAvailable" error (thanks bkno).

What's next?
We're now focused on improving online multi-player functionality. On our TO DO list are among others:

Allow activating multiple controllers per client.
Allow to select a team in the Create Party mode (this will allow you to play against AI).
Restore goal replays in online matches.
Expand the Browse Matches screen.
Correct fame points calculation for online matches.
and more...

Thanks everyone who reported issues and gave us valuable feedback, so we could improve this game. Have fun and report more :)

notes.title: Last update before online multi arrives
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/a36fb4a8688e7ad4e1bccfa20c36699afd231169.png

Hi all!

Yes, we know that you want online multi-player. We've made big progress with it, but it's not ready yet, so please be patient. At the end of June or beginning of July 2016 a playable prototype should be available for testing.

A new version 0.7 is now available which introduces important gameplay improvements. We've added header shots and bicycle kicks to the game and modified the ground passes to work similarly to lob passes. This makes the game even more skill-based, so we think it's good especially when online mode will land. More about this below.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10160134/cedfda0cefbcf1c80c9e4a57062607886e1fc77e.gif

Headers and bicycle kicks

You've requested air play and now it's ready to test. Players can now perform crazy headers and bicycle kicks during a match.

To perform one of these air shots, hold the [noparse][A][/noparse] key or (X) button while trying to stay under a falling ball. Type of shot will be selected automatically by the game depending on position of the player relative to the ball. Shot direction is always towards opponent's goal, like in regular direct shots.

Note: this feature is new and may require some rebalancing, so please report any issues or doubts on the forum.

Manual passes

Now ground passes work exactly like lob passes. The longer you hold the [noparse][S][/noparse] key or (A) button the stronger the pass. Kick direction is taken from the [noparse][▲►▼◄][/noparse] keys or (LS). Oh, and you need to receive a pass "manually", as pass receiver won't automatically run towards the ball.

This change makes the game a little more challenging, requires more precision, but also introduces more diversity in pitch situations. Kopanito is now even more skill-based. The more you play, the better you are. Hopefully this will make online multi-player more fun.

Note: this feature is new and may require some rebalancing, so please report any issues or doubts on the forum.

Other changes

Added introductory text and a new section Qualifiers to the leaderboards screen for new players.
Awarding fame for friendly matches.
Significantly reduced possibility of players being stuck in goal's net.
Revisited AI skill: made Amateur AI less accurate, made Professional and Legend AI a little worse at play, restored Beginner AI playing better when losing, otherwise it was too easy.
Displaying Steam avatar and username in game's footer.
Increased minimum fame required to advance to the Gold and Platinum leagues, respectively to 500 000 and 1 000 000 points.
Select widgets in menu now have titles.
Revisited how draws are handled in tournaments.
Disabling screen saver on game's start (thanks Sigz).
Updated icon of the teleport super-move.
Fixed crash when disconnecting a gamepad during a match (thanks el_Barto).
Ball now bounces off players that are hit on the ground.
Fixed invalid images/animations inside some alert messages.
Fixed crash when pressing [noparse][Esc][/noparse] during the loading screen.
Moved the Asia Cup to be before North America Cup on the game modes list.
Improved ball trapping, fixed some inconsistencies here, reduced a possibility of a ball passing through a player.
Removed the "Skilled" achievement.
Goalkeeper improvements:
    
    Goalkeeper can catch the ball and perform slide tackles when "returning home".
    Fixed shaking and walking in place.
    Fixed goalkeeper being idle in rare cases during a match.
    

And as always many more minor tweaks and fixes was made.

Known issues

    No Steam Overlay. It stopped working on Windows (it still isn't working on OS X and Linux too).
    Incomplete translations. We've decided to not bother our translators until the game is complete to simplify things and reduce costs. Please use english language for now.
    In rare cases there may be no fans on the stadium, only empty seats. If you experience this, then please report on the forum.


Note: please don't report issues as comments to news, because we can't respond or track them. Use Steam forums. We're reading all posts, even if we don't respond immediately.

Oh, and do not forget to infor your friends about the sale, Kopanito is now 70% off!


http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

Steam | Facebook | Twitter | YouTube | Official Site

notes.notes:

Hello!

Kopanito has been updated to v0.6.2. This is another bugfix-only release with no new features.

Full list of changes:

Fixed truncating replay buffer after each goal "Cannot set property 'elapsed' of undefined" (thanks MonkeyJug and pimmey).
Fixed unwanted whistle sound after a replay and restarting cheering sounds (thanks FUDO).
Fixed invalid camera zoom after replays.
Fixed invisible in-game menu at match start (thanks Skaery, MonkeyJug and FUDO).
Fixed crash when an unsupported language was specified in player's profile.
Fixed players dropping the ball during throw-ins.
Fixed not resuming match after a replay in some cases.
The Beginner AI doesn't increase its playing level when losing. Now it should be easier for newcomers.

As always, please report any feedback on Kopanito's forum here on Steam.

Frame-rate issues not solved yet
Sorry for that, but we're still working on this non-trivial issue. Many of you have reported stuttering on your high-end GPUs. Unfortunately it's not related to GPU performance at all. Please be patient, as hopefully v0.6.3 will land soon with a fix.

No translations or invalid ones
We've decided to not bother our translators until the game is complete to simplify things and reduce costs. Please use english language for now.

notes.title: Bugfix release v0.5.1 available
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/399820/extras/bug_fix.jpg

Hello!

Kopanito has been updated to v0.5.1. This is a bugfix-only release with no new features, no online multi-player yet, no replays and no new super-moves.

Frame-rate issues
Hopefully this issue has been fixed in this build. Game is not running faster but should be a lot more smoother. We thought that we've fixed this in previous versions, but apparently we've been wrong. Please report if the game doesn't run smoothly for you or does degrade performance over time in a match. We'll be grateful for any feedback.

Match challenges and achievements

Fixed the slide score challenge being marked as completed even when a scorer was sliding without the ball (thanks MonkeyJug).
Fixed the supershot from penalty area challenge/achievement (thanks MonkeyJug).
Fixed the clean slide tackles challenge/achievement (thanks PoDuHa-MaTb 3oBeT).


Other fixes

Fixed no one celebrating when a goal was scored using the ball magnet super-move.
Professional and Legend AI better steal the ball when an opponent is shooting using the precise shot.
Added ability to pick stadiums and balls in custom tournaments. Added new stadium choice "team stadium" which picks stadium based on selected teams' continents.
Slightly increased clock's font size to improve readability.
More randomized matches in group stages and leagues (thanks MonkeyJug).
Better way of hiding mouse cursor when starting the game (thanks Keenic).
Tweaked menu scrolling (still not perfect, but more stable and a little better).
Changed default custom tournament match time to 4 minutes.
Fixed number 1 being applied to field players sometimes (thanks MonkeyJug).
Changes height of progress bars in the trophy room.
Corrected medal for the legend mastered achievement.
Updated AI icons in the friendly match settings menu screen.


What's next?
We're working on online multi-player. First fruit of this work will be goal replays and it should land in a week or two from now. We're also preparing some new super-moves (there was freeze available in the BETA branch), but you'll need to wait for them some time, please be patient.

As always, please report any feedback on Kopanito's forum here on Steam.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/399820/

Steam | Facebook | Twitter | YouTube | Official Site

Hi, this is Kopanito's dev team! We've made many bugfixes since previous  feature update with leaderboards and challenges. In case something didn't worked for you before, you may check again now.

(Almost) Full list of changes:

Reduced accuracy of Amateur AI when doing precise shots, as it was near 100% accurate
Made the dribble distance challenge a little easier, 20 meters requirement was too hard, reduced it to 15 meters
Fixed the clean sheet match challenge to fail after an opponent scores a goal
Made the "score 3 goals in 25 seconds" challenge a little easier by extending time to 30 seconds
Fixed video settings background when there was no match playing in the background
Improved handling of gamepads on Linux (especially Ubuntu 15)
Displaying AI level and human players in the match summary screen
Displaying league rank in the bottom left corner in menu
Updated AI icon in the friendly match settings menu
Fixed reseting goal counters in the player portraits after first half
Fixed many leaderboard-related issues
Fixed tournament winner determination (thanks PoDuHa-MaTb 3oBeT)
Fixed Legendary AI level being available in friendly matches. Now it's hidden and need to be unlocked somehow.
Fixed shirt position (controlled team) in the tournament screen
Fixed disappearing in-game menu when changing language during team selection phase
Removed some background threads, which should reduce FPS drops and improve performance (please let us know if it works better for you now)
Replaced pseudo-random number generator in the game with a different algorithm, should work a little faster and more "random"

Other minor fixes and improvements
